description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI specifications in FastAPI, including handling security definitions, parameters, request bodies, responses, and paths, as well as extracting route-related model fields.

methods.name: get_openapi_security_definitions
methods.description: Generates security definitions and security requirements for an OpenAPI operation based on dependencies.

methods.name: _get_openapi_operation_parameters
methods.description: Extracts and constructs OpenAPI parameter objects from route dependencies and model fields.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_request_body
methods.description: Creates the OpenAPI requestBody object from a route's body field.

methods.name: generate_operation_id
methods.description: Generates a unique operation ID for a route and method, deprecated in favor of generate_operation_id_for_path.

methods.name: generate_operation_summary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for an operation, defaulting to route name.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_metadata
methods.description: Builds the metadata object for an OpenAPI operation, including tags, summary, description, operationId, and deprecation status.

methods.name: get_openapi_path
methods.description: Constructs the OpenAPI path item object for a given route, including responses, parameters, request body, and callbacks.

methods.name: get_fields_from_routes
methods.description: Extracts all relevant model fields from a list of routes for schema generation.

methods.name: get_openapi
methods.description: Generates the complete OpenAPI specification document from routes, including paths, components, tags, and external documentation.
